questions.question: Can an abstract class be instantiated directly?
questions.explanation: It represents an incomplete shared abstraction.

questions.question: When is an abstract class especially useful?
options: Related subclasses need shared state and partial implementation
Unrelated classes need one capability only
questions.explanation: Abstract classes combine common state, implemented methods, and required methods.

questions.question: What does an interface mainly define?
options: A capability contract implementers promise to satisfy
questions.explanation: Interfaces let otherwise unrelated classes share a behavioural contract.

questions.question: A Java class may…
options: extend one class and implement multiple interfaces
questions.explanation: Java has single class inheritance but multiple interface implementation.
